japan.name: Japan
japan.description: From neon-lit cities to serene temples, Japan is a country of contrasts — where tradition and innovation exist in perfect harmony.

destinations.name: Mount Fuji
destinations.subtitle: Iconic mountain scenery
destinations.description: Japan's most famous peak rises above lakes and forests, offering unforgettable views in every season. Explore lakeside villages, scenic trails and peaceful viewpoints beneath its snow-capped summit.

destinations.name: Kyoto
destinations.subtitle: Temples and traditions
destinations.description: Wander through vermilion torii gates, quiet bamboo groves and lantern-lit lanes. Kyoto rewards slow exploration, from traditional tea houses to centuries-old shrines tucked into green hillsides.

destinations.name: Tokyo
destinations.subtitle: The energy of the city
destinations.description: A city of dazzling contrasts: tiny ramen bars, contemporary art, peaceful gardens and neon-lit streets. Tokyo's neighbourhoods each feel like a different world waiting to be explored.

destinations.name: Okinawa
destinations.subtitle: Island escapes
destinations.description: Trade city streets for turquoise water, coral reefs and soft sandy beaches. Okinawa's subtropical islands have their own distinctive culture, cuisine and relaxed pace of life.

italy.name: Italy
italy.tagline: A timeless love affair with life.
italy.description: Ancient cities, sunlit coastlines and extraordinary food come together in a country made for lingering, wandering and discovering something beautiful around every corner.

destinations.name: Amalfi Coast
destinations.subtitle: Cliffside coastal charm
destinations.description: Pastel villages cling to dramatic cliffs above the Mediterranean. Take the scenic coastal road, linger over long lunches and find quiet coves between the lively seaside towns.

destinations.name: Rome
destinations.subtitle: Layers of living history
destinations.description: Walk through an open-air museum where ancient ruins sit beside lively piazzas. From the Colosseum to neighbourhood trattorias, Rome is best enjoyed with time to get pleasantly lost.

destinations.name: Venice
destinations.subtitle: A city on the water
destinations.description: Glide along quiet canals, cross elegant bridges and discover tiny squares away from the crowds. Venice feels most magical early in the morning and as the evening light settles.

destinations.name: Tuscany
destinations.subtitle: Rolling hills and vineyards
destinations.description: Cypress-lined roads wind through golden hills, historic villages and vineyards. Make space for farm-to-table meals, small-town markets and slow afternoons in the countryside.

france.name: France
france.tagline: Art de vivre, from city to countryside.
france.description: From iconic boulevards and world-class museums to lavender fields and Alpine villages, France invites you to savour every place at your own pace.

destinations.name: Paris
destinations.subtitle: The city of light
destinations.description: Stroll along the Seine, browse neighbourhood cafés and discover art around every corner. Beyond the famous landmarks, Paris is a collection of distinct villages full of everyday magic.

destinations.name: Provence
destinations.subtitle: Lavender and slow living
destinations.description: Stone villages, open-air markets and rolling lavender fields make Provence a place to slow down. Visit in summer for colour, or autumn for golden light and quieter roads.

destinations.name: French Riviera
destinations.subtitle: Mediterranean glamour
destinations.description: Explore seaside promenades, pebble beaches and colourful old towns along the Côte d'Azur. Mix a little glamour with coastal walks and long meals beside the water.

destinations.name: Chamonix
destinations.subtitle: Alpine mountain air
destinations.description: A gateway to dramatic peaks and alpine adventures. Ride cable cars for panoramic views, explore mountain trails and settle into a cosy café after a day outdoors.

usa.name: United States
usa.description: A vast patchwork of creative cities, spectacular national parks and road-trip landscapes — every region brings a different rhythm and a new story.

destinations.name: New York City
destinations.subtitle: The city that never sleeps
destinations.description: Iconic skylines, neighbourhood food scenes, galleries and green spaces make New York endlessly explorable. Pick a few neighbourhoods each day and let the city surprise you.

destinations.name: Grand Canyon
destinations.subtitle: Nature on a monumental scale
destinations.description: Layered red rock stretches toward the horizon in one of the world's great natural spectacles. Sunrise and sunset bring shifting colour, while rim trails offer views for every pace.

destinations.name: San Francisco
destinations.subtitle: Hills, bay and creativity
destinations.description: Ride historic cable cars, walk waterfront neighbourhoods and cross the Golden Gate Bridge. The city rewards curious wandering and a willingness to pack a light layer.

destinations.name: Yosemite
destinations.subtitle: Granite cliffs and forests
destinations.description: Towering cliffs, waterfalls and giant sequoias make Yosemite a dream for nature lovers. Scenic viewpoints are spectacular, but the quieter trails can be just as memorable.

australia.name: Australia
australia.description: Explore vibrant harbour cities, ancient landscapes, coral reefs and extraordinary wildlife across a continent built for memorable journeys.

destinations.name: Sydney
destinations.subtitle: Harbour city icons
destinations.description: A sparkling harbour, coastal walks and lively neighbourhoods set the scene. Catch the city from the water, then explore beaches and cafés beyond the postcard views.

destinations.name: Great Barrier Reef
destinations.subtitle: An underwater wonderland
destinations.description: A vast world of coral gardens and marine life lies just offshore in Queensland. Choose a responsible reef tour and discover the colours and complexity of this remarkable ecosystem.

destinations.name: Uluru
destinations.subtitle: Ancient desert country
destinations.description: This immense sandstone formation glows with changing colours through the day. Learn about its deep cultural significance and follow local guidance when visiting this sacred place.

destinations.name: Great Ocean Road
destinations.subtitle: A spectacular coastal drive
destinations.description: Wind along dramatic cliffs, surf beaches and forested stretches of southern coastline. Take your time for short walks and lookouts along this classic road trip.

india.name: India
india.tagline: A thousand worlds in one journey.
india.description: A tapestry of languages, landscapes, flavours and living traditions — from Himalayan horizons to bustling cities and tranquil tropical shores.

destinations.name: Taj Mahal
destinations.subtitle: A monument to enduring love
destinations.description: Marble domes and delicate inlay work make the Taj Mahal extraordinary at every scale. Arrive early for softer light and take time to appreciate the gardens and symmetry.

destinations.name: Jaipur
destinations.subtitle: The Pink City's royal heritage
destinations.description: Explore ornate palaces, hilltop forts and lively bazaars filled with textiles and crafts. Jaipur's warm colours and layered history make it a highlight of Rajasthan.

destinations.name: Kerala
destinations.subtitle: Backwaters and green escapes
destinations.description: Cruise quiet waterways, visit spice gardens and unwind among coconut palms. Kerala's backwaters and hill country offer a slower, nature-rich side of India.

destinations.name: Ladakh
destinations.subtitle: High-altitude Himalayan wonder
destinations.description: Vast mountain passes, clear lakes and monasteries create an unforgettable landscape. Travel slowly to acclimatise and respect the fragile high-altitude environment.
